vehicle.prado.scale_note: v3 (docs/PRADO_V3.md, tools/blender/prado_v3_build.py): overhangs stretched to 4.78 m (J150 2017+), wheelbase kept 2.79 m; pseudo-glass removed, new glass (20 % VLT side/rear, 75 % windshield); doors/hood/tailgate separated with hinge pivots; procedural cabin; brakes on static hubs; AO atlas; 21 materials. Stage 2 (tools/blender/asset_pipeline_v2.py, docs/reports/prado_v2.json): base scale x4.4747 (wheelbase 2.79 m); body/interior scaled (0.851, 0.851, 1.0) -> body width 1.887 m (excl. mirrors), height 1.843 m; wheels straightened (front toe 17.4/16.8 deg, rear +-6.3 deg -> |toe| < 0.11 deg) and scaled uniformly to 0.777 m (265/65 R17); front pair placed symmetrically. Length remains 4.47 m vs 4.78-4.84 m real (not corrected: would require non-uniform length scaling of wheel arches).
